## Def1 npm (Node Package Manager)

### Def
npm is a package manager for the JavaScript programming language. It is used to install, manage, and share packages of reusable code, as well as manage project dependencies.

### CTP
npm operates as a cmdLineTool that allows developers to install, update, and manage packages from the npm registry. It uses a `package.json` file to track project dependencies and scripts, ensuring consistent environments across development teams.

### Ex 
```{bash}
npm install express
```

::: {.callout-note}
npm is widely used in JavaScript development, especially for front-end and back-end web applications.
:::

## npm (Neural Package Manager)

### Def
In the context of neural network and machine learning frameworks, npm can refer to a package manager for managing neural network models and related components, though this usage is less common and not standardized.

### CTP
While there is no widely recognized npm for neural models, some frameworks propose similar functionalities, allowing users to manage, distribute, and version neural network models.

### Ex 
```{bash}
# Hypothetical command
npm install model:resnet
```

::: {.callout-note}
This usage is not standardized and is more of a conceptual extension rather than a real tool.
:::

## npm (Neuro-Psychological Measurement)

### Def
